Q2. Is Formula 1 only for people who want to control or manage their weight?

No. Formula 1 can complement other healthy diet elements and, together with a healthy balanced diet and physical activity, can be part of a weight-management approach. For weight control, two of the three daily meals may be replaced with an F1 Shake. Continue this until you reach your weight goal. After that, one meal per day can be replaced with a shake to help maintain weight. See the product label for detailed information.

Low-GI foods contain carbohydrates that are digested more slowly, so blood glucose may rise more gradually after a meal. blogpost.understanding-protein.title: Understanding Protein
blogpost.understanding-protein.excerpt: Protein is one part of a balanced diet. Learn the basics in simple language.
blogpost.understanding-protein.content.1: Protein is an essential nutrient used by the body for many functions. Everyday food sources can include pulses, dairy, eggs, fish, soy and other foods. The amount a person needs varies with factors such as age, body size and activity. This article is general education, not an individual nutrition plan.
blogpost.hydration-basics.title: Hydration Basics
blogpost.hydration-basics.excerpt: A simple guide to making hydration part of an everyday routine.
blogpost.hydration-basics.content.1: Hydration is part of everyday wellness. Water and other suitable fluids contribute to normal body functions. Needs can vary with weather, activity and individual circumstances. People with medical conditions or fluid restrictions should follow advice from their healthcare professional.
blogpost.fibre-in-everyday-food.title: Fibre in Everyday Food
blogpost.fibre-in-everyday-food.excerpt: Understand soluble and insoluble fibre and where they commonly appear in food.
Dietary fibre is found in plant foods. Soluble and insoluble fibre behave differently in the digestive system. Common food sources include fruits, vegetables, beans, lentils and whole grains. Gradually building a varied diet can be a practical way to include fibre. This is general educational information.
